fields.name: remaining_targets
fields.description: The list of highlighted cubes not yet successfully picked up, represented by their table-center coordinates [y, x]. Before the button-reveal interval has been observed, write the literal sentinel None, never a blank value, null, or an empty list. At the decision immediately following the button press, populate the list by matching each distinct white highlighted area seen during that interval to exactly one cube: the closest spatially adjacent cube immediately above or overlapping that area. Do not include farther cubes merely because they share the area's image column. Deduplicate repeated observations across the reveal interval and repeated associations to the same cube; store cube centers, not highlight centers. Order targets by image columns from smaller x to larger x; cubes whose x coordinates differ by at most 10 pixels count as the same column and are ordered by increasing y. This is a serialization convention only, not a pickup priority. At each decision whose supplied execution interval shows a listed cube grasped at its table location and subsequently lifted while held, remove that cube. Release or placement of an already-held cube does not establish a new pickup. Do not remove a cube merely because a pickup was commanded, and do not restore it when placed down. Preserve remaining coordinates through occlusion and minor centroid wobble. Use [] only once all revealed targets have been successfully picked up. e.g. [[63, 150]]
